subject: v-sy
title: V.SY.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 40 (BK(NM)-16). V-SY (value system) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: C-INFO (composite information) and EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). From C-INFO: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From EXP-DYM: MT-INFO-DB and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis).
